These SVG files are raw black-box outputs generated by running the user-supplied Illustrator script:

`AI脚本插件146合集-146版.jsx` → `盒型2.0` → 独立盒型

They are test evidence only. Runtime code does not load or execute the proprietary JSX, Illustrator, or any website.

The files may contain earlier groups because the original ScriptUI action appended each result to the active Illustrator document. Active regression tests select the documented result, discard empty Illustrator paths, normalize artboard translation where needed, convert points to millimetres, and compare primitive kind, path command topology, sequence, and every coordinate. Each implemented fixed model has one active fixture; airplane/mailer and custom are explicitly excluded until valid independent definitions exist.
